pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(gentle solo piano, sparse and warm)

[Verse 1]
A late us walking toward tomorrow.
A late us walking toward tomorrow, and the cup stays where I set it.
I write A Late Maybe in the margin and close the page.

[Pre-Chorus]
The piano says a late us walking toward tomorrow more quietly than I do.
I stay with A Late Maybe and do not rename it.

[Chorus]
What I can point to is a late us walking toward tomorrow.
Soft keys underline A Late Maybe and then rest.
I leave A Late Maybe where the light already was.

[Verse 2]
The evening keeps A Late Maybe and nothing larger.
A late us walking toward tomorrow.

[Piano Solo]
(expressive melodic piano solo, sustained and tender)

[Bridge]
I write A Late Maybe in the margin and close the page.
The piano says a late us walking toward tomorrow more quietly than I do.

[Chorus]
What I can point to is a late us walking toward tomorrow.
Soft keys underline A Late Maybe and then rest.
I leave A Late Maybe where the light already was.

[Outro]
(solo piano fades into soft residual notes)
A late us walking toward tomorrow, and the cup stays where I set it.
